fit.figure: Typical Pulsed Current Gain vs Collector Current (page 3; the 25 °C curve, VCE = 1 V); Base Emitter ON Voltage vs Collector Current (page 3; the 25 °C curve, VCE = 1 V); Collector-Emitter Saturation Voltage vs Collector Current (page 3; β = 10, the 25 °C curve: the middle one, its label's arrow ends on it); Common-Base Open Circuit Input and Output Capacitance vs Reverse Bias Voltage (page 3, Cibo); the same figure (Cobo); the Electrical Characteristics table: fT 250 MHz minimum at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 20 V (the sheet draws no fT figure, so its minimum is used)
fit.method: Gummel-Poon (scripts/fit_models.py). IS, NF, BF, ISE, NE, IKF, NKF and RE by least squares on the hFE and VBE(on) curves at VCE = 1 V together (points: the curves read at 1-2-5 steps); VAF 23.36 V, from the Output Admittance figure (page 5): hoe 30.0 µS at 1 mA, VCE = 10 V, so VAF = IC/hoe − VCE. BR, ISC, NC and RC by least squares on the VCE(sat) curve, the hFE points held, NR = NF, at IC/IB = 10. CJE, VJE, MJE from Cibo and CJC, VJC, MJC from Cobo against reverse voltage. TF from fT 250 MHz at 10 mA (the Electrical Characteristics table: fT 250 MHz minimum at IC = 10 mA, VCE = 20 V (the sheet draws no fT figure, so its minimum is used)), less the junctions' charging time. Fitted curves are matched within 1.3 % (hFE), 0.8 mV (VBE) and 0.7 mV (VCE(sat)). RB, VAR, TR and the temperature terms are ngspice's defaults: the sheet doesn't pin them
fit.note: The VCE(sat) curve runs to 200 mA; the fit stops at 100 mA, where the hFE curve ends. Fitted to 200 mA, the card's nearly straight VCE(sat) (no quasi-saturation in Gummel-Poon) missed the curve's upturn by 12 mV at 100 mA (137 against 149 mV); stopped at 100 mA it is within 1 mV there. NKF, the knee's exponent, ends at its bound of 1 to follow the gain's fall past 20 mA (138 at 10 mA, 87.5 at 100 mA); with IKF 0.46 A the card's current tops out near IKF/2 = 0.23 A, above the 200 mA rating
